description:
Redwood Inference is shipping a guided onboarding experience plus a “first production launch” checklist to reduce time-to-first-success and de-risk early production launches for Hosted API (and later Dedicated/Private). The project adds an in-product checklist in the Redwood Console, backed by a progress-tracking service and reliable event instrumentation across SDKs/gateway, and pairs it with updated quickstarts, docs IA, and support playbooks.

Goals:
- Reduce median time from signup → first successful API call (“TTFS”) and signup → first production traffic (“TTFP”).
- Increase activation/retention by making required steps explicit (API key creation, environment setup, first request, streaming, retries/timeouts, usage dashboard, quotas/budgets, model pinning, fallback policy, observability hooks).
- Reduce top onboarding-related support tickets (401/403 auth mistakes, rate-limit surprises, streaming disconnect confusion, billing/usage dashboard mismatches).

Scope:
- Console: checklist UI/UX, deep links into Console pages, state persistence, and admin overrides.
- Platform/Telemetry: event schema, emission points, ingestion pipeline, and KPI dashboards.
- SDKs + examples: “production-safe defaults” guidance (retries/timeouts), snippet updates, and reference apps.
- Docs: a canonical checklist doc + linked how-tos; migration notes for existing quickstarts.
- Rollout: feature-flagged release, internal dogfood, then progressive rollout by cohort.

Out of scope (MVP): full in-product guided tours, Private deployment onboarding wizard, and automated remediation suggestions (these are captured as follow-on tickets).

Stakeholders:
- Executive/Org: Alex Martinez (VP DevEx) as program sponsor; Nikhil Sharma (Dir PM Hosted API) and Marissa Cole (Dir PM Console) for product direction.
- Engineering: Dylan Brooks / Chloe Martin (Console), Ethan Park (Control Plane), Logan Wright (Telemetry), plus SDK leads under Monica Patel.
- Design: Tessa Morgan (Head of Product Design).
- Support/SRE: Dev Patel (Support) and Sean Gallagher (SRE) for top-issue reduction and reliability considerations.

Timeline (illustrative):
- Phase 0 (1–2 weeks): discovery, event schema, checklist content outline, baseline metrics.
- Phase 1 (3–4 weeks): MVP implementation (feature flag), docs + quickstart updates, internal dogfood.
- Phase 2 (2–3 weeks): cohort rollout, KPI monitoring, fixes, and support enablement.

Key deliverables:
- PRD + design spec, checklist content guidelines, onboarding event schema + ADR.
- Console checklist feature (backend + UI), telemetry dashboards, updated SDK/examples/docs.
- Release notes and operational/support playbook updates.

files.description: PRD defining target personas, MVP scope, success metrics (TTFS/TTFP), checklist steps, rollout plan, and risks/tradeoffs (self-serve vs enterprise, Hosted vs Dedicated).
Console UX spec: checklist placement, step states, deep links, empty/error states, copy guidance, and accessibility requirements; includes wireframe references and analytics hooks.
Docs IA update mapping checklist steps to docs pages (API keys, streaming, retries, quotas, usage dashboards), with redirects and ownership for each page.
Canonical checklist template used by docs and Console: step definitions, acceptance criteria, and links to quickstarts/examples per language.
SDK guidance for production defaults (timeouts, retries/backoff, idempotency, streaming reconnect patterns), and how these map to checklist steps.
Standardized event schema for onboarding/progress tracking (event names, required fields, privacy notes, cardinality constraints, and versioning strategy).
ADR documenting the decision to use server-side event emission + limited client hints, schema versioning approach, and how progress is computed (event-driven vs derived).
Implementation guide for integrating services with the checklist progress tracker (APIs, auth, idempotency, backfill, and failure modes).
Spec for dashboards: TTFS/TTFP, step completion funnel, drop-off reasons, cohort filters, and alert thresholds for regressions.
Analysis of top onboarding-related tickets (auth mistakes, 429 confusion, streaming disconnects, usage dashboard lag), plus mitigation mapping to checklist/docs/SDK fixes.
Support playbook: how to interpret checklist state, standard questions to ask, common fixes, and when to escalate to Platform/Telemetry/Console teams.
Release notes covering the new Console onboarding checklist, feature-flag behavior, known limitations, and links to updated docs/quickstarts.
Security review of onboarding telemetry: data classification, retention policy, PII avoidance, regional storage constraints, and audit considerations.
Top-level PM ticket tracking MVP scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria; links to PRD, UX spec, and KPI definitions.
Metric definition ticket: exact TTFS/TTFP calculations, exclusions, cohort logic, and validation plan against billing/usage data.
Rollout plan ticket: dogfood cohorts, gradual exposure, kill switch criteria, and comms plan for Support/CS.
Design ticket for wireframes/prototypes of checklist UI, step detail drawer, and deep-linking patterns.
Content design ticket: step names, concise copy, warnings (rate limits, quotas), and tone consistency across docs and Console.
Engineering ticket to emit server-side onboarding events at key lifecycle points (API key created, first 2xx, first streaming response, first 429, etc.).
Backend service ticket: persist step state, compute derived completion, handle idempotency, and expose APIs for Console.
Console UI ticket: checklist component, step status rendering, deep links, and error/empty states; feature flag integration.
Telemetry ticket: build dashboards for funnel and TTFS/TTFP; set regression alerts and data quality checks.
SDK ticket to add/update production-ready client defaults and snippet generation (timeouts, retries, streaming reconnect guidance).
Docs engineering ticket: add checklist docs page, update quickstarts to align with checklist steps, and ensure cross-language parity.
Data engineering ticket to backfill baseline TTFS/TTFP and approximate funnel for existing accounts to compare pre/post launch.
Ticket for admin/support override: mark steps complete/reset, audit trail, and permissions model.
Bug ticket discovered during dogfood: out-of-order events causing step regressions; requires ordering/idempotency improvements.
Security/eng ticket to validate event payloads are PII-free, document retention, and align with compliance requirements.
PR adding the checklist progress API endpoints (get state, compute completion, write-only internal event ingestion) and basic unit tests.
PR implementing Console checklist UI components, step detail views, and feature-flag gating with initial telemetry.
PR adding server-side event emission in gateway/control plane (API key creation, first successful request, streaming established).
PR introducing a feature flag for checklist exposure and cohorting rules, including kill-switch behavior.
PR adding a batch job to backfill TTFS/TTFP for existing tenants using logs/usage tables and writing results into analytics datasets.
PR fixing out-of-order event handling (idempotency keys, monotonic step transitions) and adding regression tests.
PR adding admin override endpoints + audit logging for Support/CS to reset/mark checklist steps and annotate reasons.
PR adding a packaged dashboard for onboarding funnel and TTFS/TTFP plus recommended alerts (data freshness, step drop-off spikes).
PR adding docs pages for the onboarding checklist and linking out to SDK-specific production readiness guides.
PR tightening API key creation + env var setup docs; adds troubleshooting for common 401/403 cases.
PR adding a ‘production readiness’ quickstart that mirrors checklist steps and demonstrates budgets/quotas + basic observability.
PR adding a reference streaming chat example with retry/backoff, structured logging, and a simple health check endpoint.
PR adding Python SDK presets for retries/timeouts and documenting recommended defaults; includes tests and changelog notes.
PR updating TS SDK docs/snippets to align with checklist steps and adding helper methods for safe streaming usage.
PR adding Go SDK streaming reconnect helper and example usage for resilient clients.
PR adding user-agent tagging to OpenAI-compat layer to distinguish onboarding flows and improve funnel attribution.
PR adding Terraform snippets for budget/quota alerting examples that can be linked from the checklist and docs.
